fullContentHtml:
UPSC EPFO 2025 Interview Schedule 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Interview Schedule for the post of Enforcement Officer / Account Officer / APFO. This recruitment was released for 230 posts. Applications for the UPSC EPFO EO / AO Recruitment 2025 were accepted from July 29, 2025, to August 22, 2025. The written examination is going to be conducted on 16-27 November 2026. Candidates who had qualified for this written exam can download their UPSC EPFO EO / AO Interview Schedule 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 July 2025
  • Last Date : 22 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 August 2025
  • Exam Date : 30 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 25 November 2025
  • Result Date : 22 December 2025
  • Interview Schedule : 16-27 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

  • Download Admit Card

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC EPFO 2025 Interview Schedule 2026?

UPSC EPFO 2025 Interview Schedule 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
